queer_characters.name: Bobby Lieber
queer_characters.notes: Described as an outspoken gay man deeply embedded in queer activism; a central romantic lead in a mainstream gay rom-com.

queer_characters.name: Aaron Shepard
queer_characters.notes: Explicitly a gay man whose more reserved, 'straight-acting' presentation is used to explore tensions about authenticity and assimilation within LGBTQ+ relationships.

queer_creators.name: Billy Eichner
queer_creators.notes: Openly gay; co-wrote the screenplay with director Nicholas Stoller and starred as Bobby, bringing an authentic queer perspective to mainstream filmmaking.
